subject: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v4
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v4

Hi all — sharing updated marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for AWS/GCP review. Goal is to lock language this week so we can submit listing updates without getting bounced on security claims.

Asks:
1) Security/GRC: confirm accuracy of the FAQ (esp. encryption, audit logging, SOC 2 handling, retention/residency wording). Please flag any “over-promise” statements.
2) Sales/SE: sanity-check buyer-facing talk track + top objections (marketplace procurement, Dedicated vs Private, “where does data go?”).
3) PM: confirm packaging nouns match the SKU taxonomy (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and no contradictions vs Console copy.

Docs attached:
- marketplace-security-faq-aws-gcp_v4.docx
- marketplace-listing-messaging-framework_v6.docx
- aws-marketplace-listing-copy_draft_2025-01-17.docx
- gcp-marketplace-listing-copy_draft_2025-01-17.docx

Turnaround: comments by EOD Tue (1/21) would be ideal. If we can get security sign-off by Wed, we’re in good shape for partner review.

Thanks,
Soojin

—
Soojin Lee
Product Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference



From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v4

Reviewed v4 — overall direction is good. A few required edits to keep us accurate:

1) Audit logs
- Current wording implies “customer-accessible audit logs for all actions” across all plans. We should scope:
  - Console/API audit logs are available for org/admin actions and key control plane events.
  - Inference request logs depend on customer logging configuration and retention settings.
- Suggest replacing with: “Audit logging is available for key administrative and control plane events. Log content and retention vary by plan and configuration.”

2) Encryption
- “Encryption at rest everywhere” is fine, but we should avoid implying customer-managed KMS is universal.
- Add: “Customer-managed keys (KMS) are supported for Private deployments and select enterprise configurations.”

3) SOC 2
- We can say “SOC 2 Type II” but should not imply the report is publicly shareable.
- Add: “SOC 2 report is available under NDA upon request.”

4) Data residency
- Avoid “guarantee.” Better: “Regional deployments are supported; availability varies by product and region. Customers can select a supported region for processing.”

If you want, I can drop in redlines directly; otherwise above changes should be made before we route for Aisha sign-off.

—
Marcus



From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 1:26 PM
Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v4

+1 to Marcus’ comments.

GRC-specific notes:
- For SOC 2 language: please include “period covered” is available in the report (not in the listing/FAQ). Don’t mention audit firm name in public copy.
- ISO: we should not claim ISO 27001 certification in the FAQ unless we are actually certified (we can say “aligned with” only if reviewed by Legal). Right now FAQ says “ISO 27001-ready” which will trigger questions — I recommend removing.
- Pen test: we can say “regular third-party penetration testing” but avoid “quarterly” unless we can back it with evidence.

If you send the revised v5, I can do a quick final pass for “marketplace-safe” compliance language.

Olga



From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 20, 2025 at 8:41 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v4

Sales POV:

What’s working:
- “Unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private” reads well.
- The copy is procurement-friendly without getting too enterprise-jargony.

What we need tightened for the field:
1) Dedicated vs Private quick discriminator
- Add a 2–3 line “Which should I buy?” block (Dedicated = isolation + throughput guarantees on Redwood-managed infra; Private = customer-managed networking + compliance/regulatory needs, VPC/on-prem options).

2) Marketplace procurement objections
- Add one FAQ entry: “Can I apply committed spend / EDP / marketplace credits?” with a non-committal but helpful answer (“depends on your cloud agreement; your AWS/GCP rep can confirm; Redwood supports marketplace private offers where applicable”).

3) Support expectations
- Enterprise buyers ask “Who do I call?”
- Include: “Support channels and SLAs vary by plan; enterprise support is available for Dedicated/Private.”

Markus can add SE notes on technical validation steps (esp for GCP).

Jordan



From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 20, 2025 at 10:02 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v4

SE notes:

- The GCP draft should explicitly call out the “link purchase to existing Redwood org” step and the “region mismatch” gotcha. We see this in POCs when buyer starts in us-central1 but their Redwood org is pinned elsewhere.
- Recommend adding a short “Troubleshooting” section for listings (even if we mirror it in docs):
  - entitlement pending > 30 min
  - wrong org linked
  - selected region not supported

- On security FAQ: please avoid “we never store prompts.” We do store limited operational metadata depending on settings; customers will interpret “never” literally.

If you want, I can suggest exact copy for the 3 troubleshooting bullets so it matches how support will actually handle tickets.

Markus



From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 21, 2025 at 3:18 PM
Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v5 incorporating Sec + Sales edits

Thanks all — I incorporated the feedback into v5 (not re-attaching everything to avoid inbox spam; changes summarized below; I’ll update the Drive docs shortly).

Security FAQ changes:
- Audit logs section now scoped to “key administrative + control plane events”; removed “all actions” language.
- Encryption section now clarifies customer-managed keys supported for Private + select enterprise configs (no longer implied default).
- SOC 2 line now explicitly: “available under NDA upon request.”
- Removed “ISO 27001-ready” phrasing per Olga’s note.
- Replaced “guarantee” with “supported regions vary; customers can select from available regions.”
- Removed “never store prompts” and replaced with “data handling depends on configuration; see retention/logging settings.”

Sales/SE changes:
- Added “Which plan should I buy?” block (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Added marketplace procurement FAQ re: committed spend/credits/private offers (careful wording).
- Added a short troubleshooting section (entitlement pending, wrong org, region mismatch) aligned with how Support will route.

Next step: Aisha — can you sign off on the revised security language once Drive reflects v5? I’d like to mark the FAQ as “approved for marketplace submission” by Wed.

Soojin



From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 22, 2025 at 9:07 AM
Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — v5 incorporating Sec + Sales edits

I’m OK to sign off on v5 with two conditions:

1) Add a small disclaimer at the top of the FAQ:
- “This document is for informational purposes and does not create contractual commitments. Controls and availability may vary by deployment type and customer configuration.”

2) Any references to “private offers” should not imply we can do them universally; please keep it as “may be available” and route through Sales.

Marcus/Olga — if you both confirm the final text after Soojin adds the disclaimer, consider this approved for marketplace review.

Aisha

Subject: Re: Marketplace messaging + Security FAQ for internal review (AWS/GCP) — approved language

Soojin — thanks for driving this.

Once the disclaimer is in and Marcus/Olga confirm, please:
- freeze the FAQ text as “marketplace-approved”
- use the same phrasing consistently across AWS + GCP listings, docs pages, and the internal enablement deck
- send a short note to Partnerships with the final attachments and the “do not deviate from these claims” guidance

We’ve lost time in past reviews due to subtle wording drift, so I want one source of truth.

Camila

Camila Reyes
Marketing, Redwood Inference
